observed: Clipboard rejection plus throwing legacy fallback rejected the helper and left support unopened.
Successful copy or fallback-false support opened only after a microtask and permanently disabled the support control.

resolvedFindings.finding: Current waiting feedback falsely remained pending after a prior order copy settled.
resolvedFindings.correction: Settlement removes waiting markers and changes currently rendered waiting statuses to an explicit fresh-tap instruction. No automatic copy is queued.
resolvedFindings.verification: Final product diff, cross-order VM scenarios and actual browser rerender assertion require Теперь можно and absence of ещё выполняется after settlement.

acceptanceResults: Support tap, Enter and Space call the fixed Telegram support URL during the original synchronous event-listener stack, with no order payload and no implicit clipboard write.
Support remains enabled during stalled copy, after clipboard denial/throw/missing API, and after repeated support actions. Browser fallback retains _blank and noopener.
Order copying reports pending before settlement, success only after accepted write, and a plain manual-copy fallback after failure; no legacy copy API or failure haptic is invoked.
Detached old controls cannot copy or alter current success feedback; order-ID clipboard writes serialize until actual settlement and require a fresh tap. Waiting feedback settles truthfully.
Native isolated Chrome clipboard preserves the exact literal order ID through keyboard copy; support leaves clipboard unchanged. Visible order ID remains literal text.
Reviewed 320px success/failure and 390px initial-support images show legible order, separate copy/support controls and status with no horizontal clipping.

verification.isolation: nobody + Chromium sandbox + private network + protected home; unit collected, MainPID 0, cgroup empty
verification.motionAndTimeout: Default motion, existing 5000ms action timeout and 120s unit lifetime retained; no force clicks or timeout relaxation.
verification.preflight: Evidence reports deployed original exact template GET 200 / POST 405 and unchanged active Relay/bot/Nginx identities.
verification.rollbackRehearsal: Exact fsynced atomic old-to-new-to-old replacement passes in disposable files without production changes.

nextPrerequisite.item: E4 / ACTIVITY_REFRESH_RESPONSE_ORDERING / preserve the newest activity request against obsolete success and failure
nextPrerequisite.disposition: Independently reproduced on original and final HTML; deferred to separately bounded next slice. Older history success can restore obsolete payment action; older failure can erase a fresh success.

limitations: Synthetic history/clipboard fault injection and isolated Chrome cannot establish human comprehension, live Telegram/iOS/WebKit acceptance or real support delivery.
Navigation spies did not open Telegram, send messages or transfer order data; no real money, signing, customer account reads or credentials were used by this review.

Order-ID serialization covers this copy producer only; payment/wallet/referral and external clipboard producers retain their own behavior. A submitted native write cannot be cancelled and an unresolved write continues to block only subsequent order-ID copies.
This acceptance supports the bounded reversible HTML slice; it does not close E4 or advance earlier gates. Runtime deployment verification remains the primary agent’s next step.
